plugins.name: esq-ai-practice-risk-check
plugins.displayName: ESQ CoPilot AI Practice Risk Check
plugins.description: Say "Run my AI risk check": 12 quick multiple-choice questions, about 2 minutes, then a score out of 100 in seven areas and your top 3 gaps with a next step for each. Free follow-ups in the same chat: a firm-specific AI use policy draft, an ABA Formal Opinion 512 checklist, and a check of case citations and quotations against the CourtListener case-law database. Every output is a draft for attorney review. Not legal advice.
